financial.alt: Current staffing Forms sit beside the Decision brief. Seven rostered staff minus two unavailable leave five; the inspected one-person push costs $200, with $40 contribution per additional guest and thresholds of five to cover and six to exceed expense.
financial.caption: Keep the staffing inputs beside the decision. The financial hurdle remains conditional, and Alex’s choice and specific authorization are separate records.

starter.alt: The current Forms interface shows the pinned workflow starter awaiting review beside its Decision brief. It has no accepted operating finding or recorded deployment choice.
starter.caption: The starter uses the current input and report panels while retaining the exact 1.1 rules. Supplied answers still require explicit review.

currentChoice.alt: Alex’s one-person $200 choice and its separate authorization match the accepted current assessment before the third callout. Four staff remain inside.
currentChoice.caption: Before the third callout, the brief records a current choice and matching specific authorization.

changedChoice.alt: After the explicit staffing reassessment, the Decision brief shows no current choice or matching specific authorization. The earlier records remain in history.
changedChoice.caption: After the third callout, the earlier choice and authorization no longer complete the current review.

nextAction.alt: The current brief proposes that Alex, the Venue manager, choose among the passing deployments. Only holding remains feasible.
nextAction.caption: The proposed follow-up returns to Alex; the captured continuation has no replacement choice.

fiveStaff.alt: The current operating assessment finds two fully checked feasible options when five qualified staff are available.
fiveStaff.caption: With five staff available, holding and the one-person deployment meet the recorded operating requirements.

fourStaff.alt: The explicitly reviewed reassessment finds one fully checked feasible option after a third callout leaves four qualified staff available.
fourStaff.caption: With four available, only holding meets the recorded requirements.

thirdCallout.alt: The current staffing form records three unavailable people from the seven-person roster. The Decision brief retains the $200 financial hurdle but shows no current choice or matching authorization after reassessment.
thirdCallout.caption: The changed staffing stays visible beside the changed decision. The financial hurdle cannot replace missing floor coverage.

financialReport.alt: The current input panel displays contribution and separate discount-loss Forms while the independent report panel shows Reports, Expense recovery and the conditional one-person financial hurdle.
financialReport.caption: Reports → Expense recovery keeps the supporting answer beside its financial assumptions. These are the original $40 inputs, rather than the illustrative $25 sensitivity row.

comparison.alt: The current supporting Expense recovery report compares all four deployments, their additional expense and whole additional guests needed to cover and exceed it.
comparison.caption: The four-deployment financial comparison remains visible. Inspecting an alternative records no choice or authorization.

excelCoverage.alt: Work with Excel is expanded beneath the current Forms and YAML controls, showing Download Excel, Upload Excel, Start another case and optional usage and coverage details.
excelCoverage.caption: Excel remains an optional tool beneath the input panel; opening it changes neither answers nor findings.
